create_BertEncoder: create a BertEncoder wrapping a BERT model with optional linear projection for dimensionality reduction
run_BertEncoder_forward: run the BertEncoder forward pass with token IDs, segment IDs, and attention mask tensors
use_get_model_obj: use get_model_obj to unwrap a PyTorch model from DataParallel or DistributedDataParallel wrappers
build_BertEncoder_with_linear: build a BertEncoder with an additional linear layer to reduce embedding dimensionality
review_BertEncoder_class: review the BertEncoder class that extracts CLS token or pooler embeddings from a BERT model
